name: MotherDuck
description: MotherDuck's hosted server queries your MotherDuck databases with DuckDB SQL.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp-auth.motherduck.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
